Hydra design system · Discovery · 20 Oct 2026

Reusable content molecules across ConnectED modules

A visual audit of the BOM, Release Notes, Part Search, SPEC, Admin and Content flows. It looks for cards and self-contained content blocks that repeat in at least two modules and should become one Hydra molecule driven by properties. It builds on the 19 Oct audit and this time also inventories Hydra's existing molecules. Discovery only: nothing was changed in Figma or in code.

×N = copies of the same block on one screen (counted as one sample). New since 19 Oct marks samples the previous report did not have.
Open in Figma → goes to the element when it is a normal frame. Elements inside modal slots link to the nearest linkable frame (usually the screen).
Each block ends with a Markdown copy you can paste into the PLAN prompt.

What changed since the 19 Oct audit

  • Hydra inventory audited (skipped on 19 Oct). Empty State Block is now built (1932:81, with 9 Replace-in-modules cards), so it is no longer a proposal. ExportCard exists and BOM Export uses it, so Option Card becomes an upgrade of ExportCard.
  • 3 new candidates. Outcome Summary (a watchlist item on 19 Oct; BOM now makes it 3 modules), Progress Summary Bar (new: BOM and SPEC task progress) and Tagged Summary Card (merges the SPEC Recommendation Card and the Release Note Card, both excluded as single-module before).
  • Reach grew. Selection Summary +SPEC (4 modules); Stat Tile +BOM (3 screens); Attribute List +BOM guided matching and +Admin; Part Summary Card +BOM 2.11; Option Card +SPEC division checkbox cards and +BOM Cheat Sheet entry; Flow Doc Card BOM 3 → 8 copies.
  • Corrections. BOM 1.2 "Selected file" is an Alert atom, so it was removed from Selection Summary. The Admin import result uses the Hydra Statistic atom. BOM Export cards are Hydra ExportCard instances, not BOM local components as the 19 Oct report said.
  • More evidence. 19 samples are new since 19 Oct. Former Inferred samples SPEC "File selected", Admin "confirm" and BOM 1.2 radios are now Verified. Every frame in the linked nodes was text- and instance-scanned with read-only scripts (167 frames).

Selection Summary

A soft, read-only panel at the top of a modal or step that tells the user what they are about to act on ("These parts will be added", "Adding", "Uploaded file").

New4 modules · 7 samplesContentPart SearchSPECBOM
Why new

Every module still draws this panel from plain frames inside modal slots, now in 4 modules. No Hydra molecule covers it. The Alert atom is a status message, not a "this is what you picked" summary. The anatomy is small and static (eyebrow plus 1 to 3 value lines), so a new molecule is the clean option.

Based on

none

When to use vs. related

Attribute List describes one object with label/value pairs. Selection Summary lists the objects that will be affected, under one eyebrow. For a status message such as BOM "Selected file", use the Alert atom: that panel is already an Alert instance, so it is no longer counted here.

Changed since 19 Oct

+SPEC (Confirm Master SPEC "Uploaded file") and the Content name dialogs. The BOM 1.2 "Selected file" panel was removed because it turned out to be an Alert atom.

2

Choice List Row

One compact, selectable row in a list of options (radio or checkbox), with a label, an optional secondary line and a trailing count.

New4 modules · 5 samplesContentPart SearchSPECBOM
Why new

Still hand-built in every module. The same three-part anatomy (control · label · trailing meta) repeats in 4 modules. The only differences are the content, the control type and whether a secondary line shows. Hydra Radio and Checkbox are atoms without the row chrome (padding, divider, selected fill, trailing meta).

Based on

none

When to use vs. related

Option Card (ExportCard upgrade) is for 2 to 4 rich choices with a description, icon or tag. Choice List Row is for longer, scannable lists of named things (packages, BOMs, Master SPECs), often under a search box.

Changed since 19 Oct

No new occurrences. The BOM 1.2 sample is now Verified (it was Inferred).

Attribute List

Read-only label/value pairs that describe one object, shown as a grid, as rows, or as one inline "Label: value · …" line.

New3 modules · 8 samplesPart SearchBOMAdmin
Why new

Part metadata is drawn three ways (grid, rows, inline) in Part Search and BOM, and now also as plain sentences in the Admin publish check. One molecule with a layout variant fixes the label colour, value weight, empty-value dash and spacing. In code it maps to AntD Descriptions.

Based on

none

When to use vs. related

Nested inline inside Part Summary Card. Use Selection Summary instead when you list which objects are selected rather than describing one.

Changed since 19 Oct

+BOM guided matching ("YOUR PART" on 2.11, 2.12, 2.13) and +Admin (CFM "Validation passed").

5

Outcome Summary

A summary panel at the end of a task: an optional status icon and title, a one-line explanation, then the counts as Stat Tiles.

New3 modules · 4 samplesBOMSPECAdmin
Why new

Three modules end a task by summarising what happened in the same order: status title, then a short explanation, then counts. On 19 Oct this was only on a watchlist (SPEC and Admin). BOM guided matching is now a third module. It is a small composition (text plus Stat Tiles) with no data logic of its own, so it fits as a molecule. Build it after Stat Tile.

Based on

none (the Hydra Result atom is related)

When to use vs. related

Result (Hydra atom, 204:403): full-page or centred outcomes with a large icon and buttons; keep it for empty or error pages. Alert (atom): a one-line status without counts, such as BOM 2.15 "All parts matched" or SPEC 05C "Document ready".

Changed since 19 Oct

New proposal (it was a watchlist item on 19 Oct).

Option Card (ExportCard upgrade)

A bordered card for picking one of a few rich choices (export route, document format, division, entry action), with an optional icon, tag, title, description and radio or checkbox.

Upgrade2 modules · 8 samplesBOMSPEC
Why upgrade

Hydra already has ExportCard on ❖ Cards, and the BOM Export screens now use it (remote instances). The other samples are the same card with a horizontal layout, an optional control (radio or checkbox), an optional tag and a selected state. All of these can be added as properties that default to today's ExportCard, so existing instances do not change. A separate new card would duplicate ExportCard.

Based on

ExportCard →

When to use vs. related

Choice List Row is for long, compact lists. FeatureCard (❖ Cards) is a promotional part teaser with an image and one link; do not use Option Card for that. Cards with a full-width button inside (SPEC "ConnectED Actions") are not option cards (see Excluded).

Changed since 19 Oct

**Molecule:** Option Card (ExportCard upgrade)
**Purpose:** A bordered card for picking one of a few rich choices (export route, document format, division, entry action), with an optional icon, tag, title, description and radio or checkbox.
**Decision:** upgrade
**Why:** Hydra already has ExportCard on ❖ Cards, and the BOM Export screens now use it (remote instances). The other samples are the same card with a horizontal layout, an optional control (radio or checkbox), an optional tag and a selected state. All of these can be added as properties that default to today's ExportCard, so existing instances do not change. A separate new card would duplicate ExportCard.
**Existing Hydra molecule:** ExportCard — https://www.figma.com/design/3ghYBXR6XVUEaeBo3D5E4q/Hydra-Ant-Design---DS?node-id=826-1181
**Related molecules:** Choice List Row is for long, compact lists. FeatureCard (❖ Cards) is a promotional part teaser with an image and one link; do not use Option Card for that. Cards with a full-width button inside (SPEC "ConnectED Actions") are not option cards (see Excluded).
**Destination:** Hydra file → Molecules section → ❖ Cards (ExportCard)
**Canonical sample:** BOM — 4.1 — Export · Excel/CSV (default) — https://www.figma.com/design/Ht3Up5MlRAKjK7eCuAy05L/BOM-SPEC---ASC-Connected-v2?node-id=5604-28134
**Reach:** 2 modules, 8 samples

**Upgrade gap:** The icon is a fixed nested FileExcelOutlined: no instance-swap property and not exposed. BOM 4.1 shows 4 different icons, so they were swapped by hand.; No horizontal layout.; No radio or checkbox control.; No explicit selected state; pressed is used as "selected".; No tag slot and no footer link ("Coming soon" teaser).; Description colour is overridden on some BOM instances.
**Proposed properties:** layout (variant (new): vertical | horizontal, default vertical (today)); control (variant (new): none | radio | checkbox, default none (today)); state (variant (extend): default | hover | pressed | focus | selected | disabled | loading, default default (unchanged)); show icon (boolean (new): true / false, default true (today)); ↳ 🎰 icon (instance swap (new): Hydra icon set, default FileExcelOutlined (today)); show tag (boolean (new): true / false (nested Tag, exposed), default false); show link (boolean (new): true / false, default false); ✏️ link (text (new): —, default "Tell me when available"); ✏️ title / ✏️ description (text (existing): —, default unchanged)
**Not observed:** Error state, price or metadata rows, a keyboard focus ring on the radio or checkbox variants.

7

File Upload Dropzone

A dashed drop area that walks one file through empty → uploading → selected → error, inside an upload modal.

New2 modules · 8 samplesSPECAdmin
Why new

Admin (Release Notes bulk upload) and SPEC (Upload a SPEC) built the same four-state dropzone independently, from frames, with different button emphasis, radius and progress styles. SPEC even has two uploading versions (spinner and bar). One molecule with a state variant gives both flows the same behaviour. AntD Upload.Dragger only covers the empty drop area, not the full set of states.

Based on

none

When to use vs. related

BOM "Upload a file" is an Option Card entry point that opens an upload flow, which is a different job. Progress Summary Bar is for long tasks on a page, not for a single file inside the dropzone.

Changed since 19 Oct

+SPEC uploading modal with a progress bar. SPEC "File selected" and Admin "confirm" are now Verified (they were Inferred).

8

Part Summary Card

Identifies one catalog part: thumbnail, part or SKU number (copyable), match or origin tags, name, key attributes and View Product / View PDF links.

New2 modules · 5 samplesBOMPart Search
Why new

BOM 2.11 now reuses the local "BOM / SKU Match Card / Horizontal" (Rest/Selected), which confirms it as the starting point to promote. BOM Cheat Sheet redraws the same card, and Part Search uses the same identity block as the header of every variant-download modal. Hydra FeatureCard is not an upgrade path: it is a teaser (title, description, image, one link) with no part number, tags, attributes or selected state, and adding those would restructure it.

Based on

BOM local "SKU Match Card" (promote)

When to use vs. related

Nests Attribute List (inline) for Fig / Brand / UPC. FeatureCard is for promoted parts with marketing copy. Tagged Summary Card summarises a text item, not a part. Loose draft frames of the SKU Match Card already sit on the Hydra Empty State Block page (see Open questions).

Open questions

  • Stat Tile vs the Statistic atom.

    Admin already uses the Hydra Statistic atom (stacked, coloured number). Should Admin keep it, or adopt the row Stat Tile? I recommend: Stat Tile for count rows on pages and panels, Statistic for centred numbers in result modals.

  • Outcome Summary: molecule or documented pattern?

    It is a small composition (title, description, Stat Tiles). I recommend building it as a molecule after Stat Tile, because 3 modules repeat it. If you prefer fewer molecules, document it as "Alert or heading + Stat Tile row" instead.

  • Option Card: one ExportCard upgrade for both "entry action" and "pick an option"?

    BOM uses the same card to navigate (Get started) and to choose (Export route, SPEC formats, divisions). I recommend one upgraded ExportCard with control = none | radio | checkbox.

  • File Upload Dropzone: icon treatment.

    SPEC uses a bare icon, Admin an icon in a tinted square. The plan picks the bare icon (SPEC canonical). Say if you prefer the tinted square.

  • Selection Summary: keep the success tone?

    Only SPEC "Uploaded file" uses it. Keeping tone = neutral | success is cheap; dropping it means SPEC turns neutral.

  • Tagged Summary Card: SPEC density.

    Harmonising the description to 14 px makes the 21-card SPEC grid taller. Keep 14 px (Hydra base) or allow a compact size?

  • Progress Summary Bar: warning tone.

    BOM resume strips are yellow. Keep tone = warning, or use the default card plus a warning Tag?

  • Draft frames on the Empty State Block page.

    "Frame 1" (1935:314) holds loose BOM SKU Match Card frames. Move them to a future Part Summary Card page, or delete them?

  • Flow Doc Card: where should it live?

    In Hydra → Molecules with a "Docs" prefix, or in a separate design-ops file?

Coverage

Tools: Figma MCP, read-only (create_session, get_metadata for structure, read-only use_figma scripts for text, instances, positions and measurements, get_screenshot for the visual check), then local crops. Method: a text and instance scan of every frame in the linked nodes, a visual pass on representative screens, then measurements of each sample for the harmonization tables. Access: all 7 linked nodes opened; no failures. Archived work: no pages, sections or frames named Archive, Old, WIP, Exploration or Deprecated inside the linked nodes; hidden images on the BOM page root were skipped. Both Admin pages carry a 🚧 prefix ("Release Notes Manager", "Content File Manager"); they were audited because they were linked explicitly.
